reasoning: Three ascending vertical bars represent either a simple bar chart (statistics, analytics, growth metrics) or cellular signal strength bars. While it looks like a UI status indicator for signal level, it is also the standard minimal glyph for charts, analytics, and KPIs, which are common subjects of work and finance tasks.

pass1.ambiguity: Strongly ambiguous between a 3-bar ascending bar chart (statistics/metrics) and a cellular reception signal indicator.
